"An Indian tourist named Vijaya Lakshmi Gali fell into an 8-metre-deep sinkhole while walking along a road in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, on 23 August. She disappeared entirely, and the only trace found of her has been her slippers.

***

Rescue teams have employed extensive methods in their efforts to locate her, including tracker dogs, remote cameras, ground-penetrating radar, high-pressure water jets, and excavators to clear debris from the underground drainage system.

***

However, after eight days of searching, authorities declared the operation too risky to continue. Two divers who entered the drainage system on Thursday had to be pulled out due to dangerous conditions before they could reach a key obstacle blocking their path.

***

* Dr Zaliha Mustafa, a minister in the prime minister's department, cited the safety and health of rescue personnel as the primary reason for halting operations, noting that the hazardous underground conditions made further exploration extremely perilous for those involved.

***

Notably, authorities revealed that a soil slip had been reported at the very same location the previous year, raising serious questions about infrastructure maintenance and whether adequate measures were taken to prevent such a devastating incident from occurring in a busy area of the Malaysian capital.

Is there anything else I can help with?"
